About AI Listi

AI Listi is a curated directory of the artificial intelligence ecosystem, listing 3,017 AI tools across 163 categories — from AI chatbots, coding assistants and writing tools to image generation, video generators, AI agents, marketing and SEO software. Every listing shows the official logo, the pricing model (free, freemium or paid), the category and the official website, so you can compare AI apps and pick the right one in minutes.

The directory goes beyond tools: it also tracks 574 AI models and large language models, 806 AI companies, 222 AI hardware devices and chips, 113 AI agent skills, and 350 profession guides that collect the best AI tools for a specific job. Search for any AI tool by name, or filter by category, price and use case — the directory works on mobile and desktop, no account needed.

Frequently asked questions

What is AI Listi?

AI Listi is a curated directory of the artificial intelligence ecosystem. It lists 3,017 AI tools in 163 categories, plus 574 AI models, 806 AI companies, 222 hardware devices and 350 profession-specific guides — each with its official logo, pricing and website.

Is AI Listi free to use?

Yes. Searching, browsing and comparing AI tools on AI Listi is completely free, requires no account, and your bookmarks are stored privately on your own device.

How do I find the best AI tool for my needs?

Type what you need — for example 'video generator', 'code assistant' or 'writing' — into the search bar, then narrow the results by category and pricing (Free, Freemium or Paid). You can also browse all 163 categories or open a profession guide to see the AI tools recommended for a specific job.

What kinds of AI tools are listed?

The directory covers chatbots and AI assistants, coding and developer tools, writing and copywriting assistants, image generation and editing, video generators, music and audio, AI agents, marketing, SEO and sales tools, productivity and automation, plus specialized AI tools for healthcare, finance, legal, education and more.

How current is the directory?

The directory was last updated in November 6, 2026. Every listing includes the tool's official website and logo, its pricing model and category, and discontinued tools are clearly marked.

Privacy policy

The short version: AI Listi collects no personal data, uses no cookies or analytics, and stores everything it remembers directly on your own device.

Effective November 10, 2026 · AI Listi (ailisti.com)

1. Overview

AI Listi is a public directory of AI tools, models, companies, hardware and skills. You can browse, search, filter and bookmark everything without an account — there is no sign-up, no login and no paywall. This policy explains what happens to your data (almost nothing) when you use the site.

2. Information we do not collect

We do not collect, store or process personal information. We do not ask for your name, email address or location; we do not run analytics, advertising or tracking scripts; and we do not use cookies of any kind. The site works entirely in your browser, and nothing you search for or open is sent to a server.

3. Information stored on your device

The only data AI Listi keeps lives in your browser's local storage, on your device, and is never transmitted anywhere. It consists of: your saved/bookmarked tools (ailisti_saved_v1), your light/dark theme preference (ailisti_theme), and — only if you use the admin dashboard — your content edits and admin session (ailisti_admin_v1, ailisti_admin_session). Clearing your browser data removes all of it.

4. Third-party links and trademarks

Every listing links to the official website of the tool, model, company or project it describes. When you follow one of those links you leave AI Listi, and the privacy policy of the destination site applies. Product names, logos and brands are the property of their respective owners and are shown for identification purposes only.

5. Content submissions

The "Submit a Tool" form lets you suggest a new listing. The suggestion is stored locally in the site's admin review queue — it is not transmitted to an external server. Please include only information you are comfortable saving on the device, or send your suggestion to us by email instead.

6. Children's privacy

AI Listi is a general-audience reference directory and is not directed at children under 13. Because the site collects no personal information from anyone, no data is knowingly collected from children.

7. Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the updated version will be published on this page with a new effective date, so the version you see here is always the current one.

8. Contact

Questions about this policy or the site? Email contacttosharif@gmail.com, or find us on Facebook and YouTube.
